body.name: I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}
body.construction:
Let \(m=\lfloor n/4\rfloor\), let
\[
 F_j=\{(j-1)m+1,\ldots,jm\},\qquad j=1,2,3,4,
\]
and ignore observations with index larger than \(4m\).  If \(m=0\), set
\(I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}=\Theta\).  Otherwise put \(p=0\) when \(s=1\) and
\(p=1\) when \(s>1\), and define, on \([0,1]\),
\[
 K_0(u)=1,\qquad K_1(u)=4-6u,
\]
with both kernels set to zero off \([0,1]\).  Thus
\[
 \int_0^1K_p(u)\,du=1,
 \qquad
 \int_0^1uK_1(u)\,du=0.
\]
For \(V\in\{D,Y\}\), a fold \(j\), a bandwidth \(h>0\), and a center
\(t\in[0,1]\), define the fixed-denominator boundary-kernel contrast
\[
 \widehat\Delta_{j,h}^{V}(t)
 =\frac{1}{mh}\sum_{i\in F_j}V_i
 \left\{
 K_p\!\left(\frac{X_i-t}{h}\right)
 -K_p\!\left(\frac{t-X_i}{h}\right)
 \right\}.
\]
Set
\[
 H=\left(\frac{\kappa_n}{2^{12}M}\right)^{1/s},
 \qquad
 J_H=\left\lfloor\frac{32}{H}\right\rfloor,
 \qquad
 \mathcal G_H=\left\{\frac14+\frac{jH}{64}:0\le j\le J_H\right\}.
\]
In particular, \(N_H:=|\mathcal G_H|\le1+32/H\).  On fold one let
\[
 \mathcal R_H
 =\left\{t\in\mathcal G_H:
 \widehat\Delta_{1,H}^{D}(t)
 \ge \max_{q\in\mathcal G_H}\widehat\Delta_{1,H}^{D}(q)
       -\frac{\kappa_n}{8}\right\}
\]
and let
\[
 \mathcal A_H
 =\bigcup_{t\in\mathcal R_H}[t-H,t+H]\cap[1/4,3/4].
\]
For every connected component \([a,b]\) of \(\mathcal A_H\), include
\(a,b\) and the points \(a+j/n\le b\); call the resulting finite set
\(\mathcal G_n(\mathcal A_H)\).  Define
\[
 \overline\Delta_H^D(t)
 =\frac12\left\{
 \widehat\Delta_{2,H}^{D}(t)+
 \widehat\Delta_{3,H}^{D}(t)
 \right\},
 \qquad
 \widehat c
 =\min\mathop{\rm arg\,max}_{t\in\mathcal G_n(\mathcal A_H)}
 \overline\Delta_H^D(t).
\]
The minimum supplies deterministic tie breaking.  Put
\(b=m^{-1/(2s+1)}\) and, with
\(L_\alpha=\log(32/\alpha)\), put
\[
 R_c=\frac{2^{16}L_\alpha}{m\kappa_n^2}+\frac1n
\]
and
\[
 r_n
 =8Mb^s+\frac{16\kappa_nR_c}{b}
   +16MH^{s-1}R_c
   +8\|K_p\|_\infty
       \sqrt{\frac{L_\alpha}{mb}}.
\]
If either \(R_c>H/8\) or \(r_n>\kappa_n/8\), set
\(I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}=\Theta\).  If both checks pass, define on fold four
\[
 \widehat y(\widehat c)=\widehat\Delta_{4,b}^{Y}(\widehat c),
 \qquad
 \widehat d(\widehat c)=\widehat\Delta_{4,b}^{D}(\widehat c).
\]
The passing inequality \(8Mb^s\le\kappa_n/8\), together with
\(M\ge2\) and \(\kappa_n\le1/8\), ensures
\(b<1/4\), so these kernel windows lie in \([0,1]\).  If
\(\widehat d(\widehat c)<\kappa_n/2\), again set
\(I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}=\Theta\).  In the remaining case define the sample
map
\[
 I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}
 =\operatorname{hull}\left\{\theta\in\Theta:
 \left|\widehat y(\widehat c)
       -\theta\widehat d(\widehat c)\right|\le2r_n\right\},
\]
where the hull of the empty set is the empty interval.  Every grid,
normalization, threshold, tie rule, fallback, and critical radius in this
display is deterministic given \((n,s,M,\kappa_n,\alpha)\), so this is a
measurable map of \((O_1,\ldots,O_n)\).
